description: Unit test class for CreatePolicy in the policies modification commands package, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and instance creation.

classes.name: CreatePolicyTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for CreatePolicy, validating immutability, equality, JSON serialization, and object creation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that CreatePolicy instances and related Policy and JsonObject instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals for CreatePolicy.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicy
methods.description: Ensures that passing null as a policy throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Checks that creating a policy with an invalid ID throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: createInstanceWithValidPolicyId
methods.description: Tests creation of CreatePolicy instance with a valid policy ID.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization from JSON and correctness of the resulting CreatePolicy object.
